problem.passage: During the 1890s, several American cities debated whether to replace horse-drawn streetcars with electric trolleys, a shift that promised faster commutes but required expensive overhead wiring. City councils in Denver and Cleveland approved the conversion within a year of each other, yet the two projects unfolded on strikingly different timelines. Denver's utility company secured financing quickly and completed its electrified lines within eighteen months, while Cleveland's project stalled for nearly four years because of disputes over which neighborhoods would bear the cost of new poles and cables. ______ Denver residents enjoyed faster, quieter commutes well before Cleveland's system opened, even though both cities had approved electrification at roughly the same time.
problem.stimulus: During the 1890s, several American cities debated whether to replace horse-drawn streetcars with electric trolleys, a shift that promised faster commutes but required expensive overhead wiring. City councils in Denver and Cleveland approved the conversion within a year of each other, yet the two projects unfolded on strikingly different timelines. Denver's utility company secured financing quickly and completed its electrified lines within eighteen months, while Cleveland's project stalled for nearly four years because of disputes over which neighborhoods would bear the cost of new poles and cables. ______ Denver residents enjoyed faster, quieter commutes well before Cleveland's system opened, even though both cities had approved electrification at roughly the same time.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 지문은 덴버가 빠르게 자금을 확보해 18개월 만에 전차선을 완공한 반면, 클리블랜드는 비용 부담을 둘러싼 갈등으로 4년 가까이 지연되었다는 원인을 제시한 뒤, 그 결과로 덴버 주민들이 클리블랜드보다 먼저 더 빠르고 조용한 통근을 누렸다는 결과를 서술한다. 이는 전형적인 원인-결과 관계이므로 'As a result,'가 이 인과 관계를 정확히 표시한다. 'In addition,'은 마지막 문장을 앞 내용과 무관한 추가 정보처럼 취급해 인과 관계를 놓친다. 'For instance,'는 마지막 문장을 앞선 주장의 예시로 취급하지만, 실제로는 예시가 아니라 그 원인의 직접적 결과다. 'Similarly,'는 마지막 문장이 앞 내용과 유사한 별개의 사례인 것처럼 암시하지만, 실제로는 앞서 설명된 지연의 결과이지 유사 사례가 아니다. 따라서 정답은 A번이다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage establishes a cause (Denver secured financing quickly and finished in 18 months, while Cleveland stalled for nearly four years due to cost disputes) followed by an effect (Denver residents enjoyed faster commutes before Cleveland's system opened). This is a classic cause-and-effect relationship, so 'As a result,' correctly marks it. 'In addition,' treats the final sentence as unrelated extra information, missing the causal link. 'For instance,' misreads the final sentence as an example rather than a direct consequence. 'Similarly,' wrongly implies the final sentence is a comparable but separate case rather than the result of the previously described delay. Therefore, the correct answer is A.

key_relations: Denver secured financing quickly and finished in 18 months; Cleveland stalled for 4 years due to cost disputes — this is a cause (financing speed/dispute) leading to an effect (timeline difference)
both cities approved electrification at the same time, so the difference in outcome is caused specifically by the financing/dispute issue, not by approval timing
the final sentence states a consequence (Denver residents got faster commutes sooner) that follows directly from the earlier described delay in Cleveland
design.answer_uses_relations: The correct transition 'As a result,' signals that the final sentence is a consequence of the previously described difference in project timelines (fast financing in Denver vs. stalled negotiations in Cleveland), correctly capturing the causal relation while implicitly acknowledging that approval timing was NOT the cause (since both approved simultaneously).

distractor_design.relation: treats the sentence as an additional, unrelated fact rather than a consequence of the timeline difference
treats the final sentence as an example illustrating the prior claim rather than a caused result
incorrectly suggests the final sentence parallels/restates the prior claim rather than resulting from it

problem.evidenceSpan: ______ Denver residents enjoyed faster, quieter commutes well before Cleveland's system opened
problem.answerRationale: 'As a result,' correctly marks the final sentence as a consequence flowing from the causal chain described earlier (quick financing versus stalled disputes), properly subordinating the effect to its cause rather than coordinating it as a separate or parallel idea.

difficultyReasons: 필요한 추론 단계: 앞 문장의 인과 관계(자금조달 속도/분쟁 → 완공 시기 차이)를 파악하고, 마지막 문장이 그 결과임을 연결해야 하므로 2단계 정도
핵심 관계의 미묘함: 원인(자금조달/분쟁)과 결과(통근 혜택 시기)를 정확히 구분해야 하며, 승인 시기가 동일했다는 정보에 현혹되지 않아야 함
오답이 정답과 공유하는 정보: 세 오답 모두 지문의 표면적 사실(승인 시점 동일, 구체적 사례, 추가 정보처럼 보이는 서술)과 일부 일치하여 그럴듯함
전이어 자체가 문법적 오류가 아니라 논리적 관계 오류이므로 신중한 독해가 필요함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 학생이 마지막 문장을 앞 내용에 덧붙이는 별개의 정보로 오인할 수 있음
distractors.matches: 두 도시 모두 관련된 통근/전철 이야기라는 점에서 표면적으로 연결됨
distractors.whyWrong: In addition은 새로운 독립적 정보 추가를 뜻하지만, 마지막 문장은 앞서 설명된 타임라인 차이의 직접적 결과이므로 인과관계를 나타내는 접속어가 필요함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 마지막 문장이 앞의 주장을 구체적으로 보여주는 사례처럼 보일 수 있음
distractors.matches: Denver와 Cleveland의 구체적 상황이 예시처럼 서술되어 있다는 점과 일치
distractors.whyWrong: For instance는 일반적 진술 뒤에 구체적 예를 드는 관계를 나타내지만, 이 문장은 앞 내용의 예시가 아니라 그 결과이므로 부적절함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 두 도시 모두 전철화를 승인했다는 유사성 때문에 비교/유사 관계로 착각할 수 있음
distractors.matches: ‘both cities had approved electrification at roughly the same time’라는 문구와 표면적으로 일치
distractors.whyWrong: Similarly는 유사한 상황을 병렬적으로 제시할 때 쓰이지만, 마지막 문장은 오히려 결과(빠른 통근 혜택)를 설명하며 두 도시의 차이(대조)를 강조하므로 유사성 접속어는 부적절함
